name: ci-speedup
description: Measured GitHub Actions speed-up without dropping any required check: inventory every check, baseline the last N runs into queue/setup/test per job and the critical path, diagnose against a slow-CI pattern catalog, simulate sharding, implement behind required-check guardrails, verify on warm-cache reruns, iterate, and deliver a before/after comparison. Manual (/ci-speedup); the model never triggers it, because it pushes several rounds and spends CI minutes. Not for fixing a failing CI (diagnosing-bugs) or building CI from scratch (eng-init).
